name: Olara

values.lender: One Investment Management; Sculptor Real Estate; Octo Capital; Zeckendorf Development

notes: The height is stated as approximate and is the only figure ever published; it is carried forward because the storey count in the same sentence is unchanged in later reporting. Gabellini Sheppard Associates is the interior designer, not the architect. Two earlier facilities are excluded from the lender field: a $50.1m loan funding demolition and initial phases, and a $5m mezzanine loan. The October 2025 round-up carries a separate heading and self-contained paragraph per project, so the contractor and lender sentences are unambiguously about this one.

quotes.architect: Designed by Arquitectonica with interiors and amenities crafted by New York based firm Gabellini Sheppard Associates, Olara will offer two- to four-bedroom plus den residences.
quotes.contractor: Gilbane Building Company and SavCon are listed as the general contractors, with completion anticipated in 2027.
quotes.lender: A consortium of lenders, including One Investment Management, Sculptor Real Estate, Octo Capital, and Zeckendorf Development, provided a $380 million construction loan earlier this year.
quotes.stories: Olara, or Olara West Palm Beach, is a two-tower 26-story waterfront condominium development located at 1919 North Flagler Drive by Savanna Fund that broke ground in August 2025.
quotes.height_ft: New renderings have been unveiled, offering a first glimpse at the amenity spaces of Olara, a mixed-use development set to rise 26 stories and approximately 329 feet along West Palm Beach's Intracoastal Waterway.

name: The Nora Hotel
notes: STATUS SIGNAL NOT ACTED ON: at least six outlets report the hotel opened to guests on 19 October 2026 with 201 rooms. None is on the acceptable-source list, and the one that is — the South Florida Business Journal — could not be retrieved, because bizjournals.com refuses both the search crawler and a direct fetch with a browser user-agent. Florida YIMBY has published nothing since the May 2025 topping-off, and The Real Deal, Commercial Observer and Bisnow carry no opening story. The City's permit portal and the county appraiser both returned HTTP 500 to automated requests and the state lodging-licence search found no record. The row therefore stays Under Construction and this note carries the signal; a human with access to the SFBJ article should flip it to Complete. The project is also addressed as 1135 N Railroad Avenue in post-opening coverage.

quotes.contractor: Moss Construction is serving as the general contractor, bringing its extensive experience in large-scale hospitality projects to the job site.

name: Palm Beach Atlantic University residence hall
notes: The role stated is design-builder rather than general contractor, and it is recorded in the contractor field because the design-builder is the constructing party. Gilbane Building, the contracting arm, is a distinct entity from Gilbane Development, which is stored as developer, and the source lists both separately in the same sentence — so this is not an inference from the developer's name. The lender stays empty: the project is financed through county revenue bonds with a bank as underwriter and a conduit borrower, none of which is a construction lender. A floor-area conflict to review: this source says 319,000 sq ft against the 358,400 stored.

quotes.contractor: As design-builder, we're proud to bring this vision to life alongside Palm Beach Atlantic University, Gilbane Development, Cube3, and our trade partners.

name: The Mandarin Oriental Residences, West Palm Beach
notes: Feet above ground, from the coverage of the City of West Palm Beach Planning Board approval, consistent with the 31 storeys already stored.

quotes.height_ft: At 380 feet tall, the building would rank among the tallest in West Palm Beach.

name: Alida Residences and Tribute Portfolio by Marriott Hotel
notes: The project now has a published street address, 506 Datura Street, which replaces the placeholder this row was recorded with. The 21 storeys are the residential building; the hotel is a separate structure whose storey count is unpublished. The lender correctly stays empty — as of the July 2026 groundbreaking no construction loan had been secured.

quotes.residential_units: Alida Residences will contain 181 rental units in studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom configurations.
quotes.hotel_rooms: The separate 112-key hotel will mark Tribute Portfolio by Marriott's entry into the West Palm Beach market.
quotes.stories: the approximately 350,000-square-foot transit-oriented development will include a 21-story residential building with 181 rental units and a separate 112-key hotel

name: 2085 North Flagler Drive
notes: The same article contains a sentence naming two further partners on a Terra project, but that paragraph is about a different scheme in Miami Beach, so those firms are not added here. This address is a distinct project from 1919, 2001 and 1865/1901 North Flagler.

quotes.residential_units: Plans currently call for 281 condos that would measure 1,065 to 4,510 square feet; the average home would span 1,762 square feet.

name: 2001 North Flagler Drive
notes: The named affiliate matches this row's owner of record, which corroborates the attribution rather than resting on the LLC name. Residential units are deliberately not stored: the source gives 90 condominiums and eight lower-level townhouses separately and prints no total, so 98 would be arithmetic of mine. This is a different project from the Ritz-Carlton at 1717 N Flagler, also a Related Group and BH Group venture, and the two must not be merged.

quotes.developer: Related Group and BH Group, through their affiliate, 2001 N. Flagler Drive Owner LLC, want to transform a 0.78-acre site into a high-rise luxury tower.

quotes.developer: Rybak Development and Gold Standard of Care are the two developers; they are based in New York and Fort Lauderdale, respectively.

name: Deco Northwood
notes: The architect stays empty deliberately: the only firm named on the design is the developer's in-house studio, credited for the style and the renderings, which is not an architect-of-record statement. Municipality checked — 2900 Broadway is inside the City of West Palm Beach, in Northwood, and not Mangonia Park, which begins further north on the same road.

quotes.developer: The Prime Company is the developer; it's working with in-house Prime Design on the style and architectural renderings.

name: South Flagler House
notes: SUPERSEDES the 108 units previously stored, which came from a multi-project round-up. The topping-off article is both more recent and single-project. The same article also resolves the attribution doubt recorded against that round-up: its general-contractor sentence sits in this project's own section, which confirms the contractor already stored.

quotes.residential_units: The development consists of 105 two to five bedroom residences across two identical 28 story structures known as the North Tower and the South Tower.
